**Role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Your task is to code a complete, production-ready landing page on the first attempt — no TODOs, no partial builds, no stub sections. The page markets a personal finance management SaaS and must feel secure, efficient, intuitive, clean, modern, trustworthy, and organized (Corporate & SaaS tone).

- **Theme Name:** Secure Finance Flat Design (translated from source: "Flat Design Financeiro Seguro")

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and style-agnostic — retheming the site must require editing only the CSS file, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens**
Store every visual token in `:root` (light) and `.dark` (dark) using exactly these values:

- **Light theme (`:root`):**
  - Brand: `--primary: #005691` (Deep Blue — main actions, links, active nav), `--primary-hover: #00477F`, `--primary-bright: #005691` (focus rings/accents), `--secondary: #2ECC40` (Emerald Green — positive status, success fills, highlights), `--secondary-hover: #26B238`
  - Accents: `--accent-gold: #FFD700`, `--accent-orange: #FF8C00`, `--accent-purple: #9370DB` (chart series/graphics only — never body text)
  - Backgrounds: `--bg-primary: #F0F0F0`, `--bg-secondary: #FEFEFE`, `--bg-tertiary: #E4E4E4` (chart tracks, inset panels)
  - Text: `--text-primary: #333333`, `--text-secondary: #555555`, `--text-on-primary: #FFFFFF` (pairs with `--primary` fills), `--text-on-secondary: #0A3D12` (pairs with `--secondary` fills), `--text-success: #1B7A2A`, `--text-error: #C0392B`
  - Status: `--status-positive: #2ECC40`, `--status-negative: #E74C3C`
  - Borders: `--border-default: #D6D6D6`, `--border-strong: #333333`, `--border-success: #2ECC40`, `--border-error: #E74C3C`
  - Shape/motion/depth: `--radius-sm: 4px`, `--radius-md: 8px`, `--radius-lg: 12px`, `--shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 rgba(51,51,51,0.10)`, `--shadow-md: 5px 5px 0 rgba(51,51,51,0.14)`, `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 0.15s ease-in-out`, `--transition-normal: 0.2s ease-in-out`, `--ease-standard: ease-in-out`, `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`, `--font-base: "Inter", sans-serif`
- **Dark theme (`.dark`):** `--primary: #0E6FA8`, `--primary-hover: #1581C4`, `--primary-bright: #5AA9E6`, `--secondary: #3DDC55`, `--secondary-hover: #55E56E`, `--accent-gold: #FFD700`, `--accent-orange: #FF9F3E`, `--accent-purple: #B39DDE`, `--bg-primary: #0D1B26`, `--bg-secondary: #14293A`, `--bg-tertiary: #1B3548`, `--text-primary: #F2F6F9`, `--text-secondary: #A8BACC`, `--text-on-primary: #FFFFFF`, `--text-on-secondary: #062D10`, `--text-success: #3DDC55`, `--text-error: #FF6B6B`, `--status-positive: #3DDC55`, `--status-negative: #FF6B6B`, `--border-default: #2A4356`, `--border-strong: #A8BACC`, `--border-success: #3DDC55`, `--border-error: #FF6B6B`, `--shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.40)`, `--shadow-md: 5px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.50)` (all other tokens unchanged)
- **Contrast Pairing (mandatory in both themes):** Light backgrounds (`--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`) pair only with dark text tokens; dark backgrounds pair only with light text tokens. `--primary` fills pair with `--text-on-primary`; `--secondary` (emerald) fills pair with `--text-on-secondary` — never white text on emerald. Warm accent fills (gold, orange) pair with `--text-primary` in light mode. `body` must bind `background`, `color`, and `font-family` to the tokens.
- **Exception clause (background):** The source palette lists #FFFFFF; per the background standard, the page background must be `--bg-primary: #F0F0F0` and elevated surfaces `--bg-secondary: #FEFEFE` — #FFFFFF must never be used as a background fill.
- **Exception clause (flat shadows):** The source spec demands `box-shadow: none`; for this flat theme, `--shadow-sm`/`--shadow-md` must resolve to the hard-edged solid offsets specified above (zero blur), and soft/blurred shadows are forbidden.
- **Exception clause (borders):** The source's `border: none` applies to UA default borders only; flat 1px solid borders via `--border-default` are the required separation and elevation device.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- **Implementation:** Define the dark token set under both a `.dark` class selector and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (no-JS fallback), with a `.light` class override for explicit light selection.
- **Theme Switching:** Background and text variables must swap seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring. Apply the stored preference before first paint to prevent a flash of the wrong theme.
- **Persistence:** Persist the user's choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Include a visible toggle in the header with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode") and a Material Symbol icon (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`).

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- **Default Alignment Rule:** Build all layout structures with Flexbox. Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., `stretch` for equal-height card grids).
- **Mobile-Friendly First:** All flex rows must collapse to columns below ~768px; the page must never scroll horizontally at any viewport width from 320px up. Use a single max-width container (~1140px) with section padding built from `--spacing-gap` multiples.

**1.5 Framework Default & Styling Approach**
- Use hand-authored, clean custom CSS in `style.css` organized with Tailwind-style `@layer base, components, utilities` discipline (or include Tailwind and use it only for flex/spacing utilities). All component styling must live in `style.css` bound to the CSS variables, exposed through generic reusable classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- **Text:** Include the Google Fonts `<link>` for Inter (weights 400, 500, 600, 700, 800) and bind it to `--font-base`. Base body size ≥16px, generous line-height, clear h1–h4 hierarchy, exactly one `<h1>`.
- **Icons:** Use Google Material Symbols (Rounded or Outlined) loaded via `<link>`. Forbidden: raw inline SVGs, emoji as UI icons, local icon files.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component Requirements** — base `.btn` class with BEM variants
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, `--radius-md`, Inter 600. Variants: `.btn--primary` (deep blue fill + `--text-on-primary`), `.btn--secondary` (flat outline: 2px `--border-strong`, transparent background), `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger` (flat red fill + white text), `.btn--success`.
- **Hover:** Darkened hover token or brightness shift plus `--shadow-sm` hard offset; `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** Distinct `:focus-visible` ring — 2px solid `--primary-bright` with 2px offset, clearly visible in both themes.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` click feedback.
- **Loading:** `.is-loading` class — CSS border spinner, button dimensions preserved, `aria-busy="true"`, pointer-events disabled to prevent double-clicks.
- **Disabled:** `[disabled]` — `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale filter, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** Temporary feedback classes swapping background to `--text-success`/`--text-error` tokens with a check/error Material Symbol, without layout shift.

**2.2 Card Component Requirements**
- **Default:** Flexible flex-column layout, `--bg-secondary` background, 1px `--border-default` border, `--radius-lg`, token-driven padding.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus `--shadow-sm` hard offset (interactive cards only).
- **Focus-within:** Card border highlights to `--primary` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` flat shimmer — a two-tone opacity pulse between flat grays (no gradient glow) — reserving final dimensions to prevent layout jumps.
- **Empty State:** `.card--empty` fallback layout with a Material Symbol and short guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements** — used in the Final CTA email capture
- **States:** Empty, Focused (2px `--primary-bright` ring), Filled, Valid (`--border-success` + check icon), Invalid (`--border-error` + error icon + message, `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`), Disabled, Read-only.
- **Structure:** `.input-group` flex-column wrapper containing a `<label>`, the input, and a dedicated error-feedback container announced via `aria-live="polite"`. Never rely on color alone — every error pairs an icon with text.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements** — apply to any dialog implemented; at minimum define the styles
- **States:** Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing — all animated with `--transition-normal`.
- **UX Features:** Centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`) with backdrop, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trap, `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal` + `aria-labelledby`, body scroll lock, close via `Esc` and overlay click, `--z-modal` stacking. The FAQ must be an accordion, not a modal.

**2.5 Theme-Specific Components (mandatory)**
- **`.data-chart-flat`:** Pure-CSS flat charts — flex bar charts built from divs (with visible value and month labels), donut charts via `conic-gradient`. Bars colored `--status-positive`/`--status-negative` by data meaning; never color-only. Bars grow in (scaleY from the bottom) on scroll into view, disabled under reduced motion.
- **`.status-indicator`:** Flat chip = colored dot + Material Symbol (`trending_up` / `trending_down` / `trending_flat`) + text with explicit sign (e.g., "+$2,450 this month" green, "−$860 overspend" red). AA contrast in both themes.
- **`.security-icon-simple`:** Flat square tile (`--radius-sm`, 2px solid border or flat fill) containing exactly one Material Symbol (`lock`, `shield`, `verified_user`, `key`, `https`, `sync_lock`). Hover triggers the sway animation (Section 3).

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** Fluid type and spacing; breakpoints without horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth, Fast Animations:** Every state change uses `var(--transition-normal)` (0.2s ease-in-out) or `var(--transition-fast)`, honoring the source spec's timing; transition explicit properties rather than `all` where performance matters.
- **Sway/Balance Micro-interactions:** Define `@keyframes sway` (rotate −1.5° → 1.5° → 0) applied on hover/focus to `.security-icon-simple` tiles, feature icons, and the hero mockup. Every click, hover, and submission must produce visible feedback (button press scale, chip pulse, chart bar growth, price change).
- **Reduced Motion:** Wrap sway, grow, and reveal animations in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and replace with instant or opacity-only changes.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both themes; semantic landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`) plus a skip-to-content link; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability for nav, accordion, toggles, and forms; `aria-live` regions for form feedback and pricing updates; never communicate state by color alone; visible focus on every interactive element.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** No interaction may occur without a perceivable state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.
- **Sticky Header:** Solid `--bg-secondary` with a 1px bottom border (no blur), stacked below `--z-dropdown`/`--z-modal`/`--z-toast`.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

- **File Structure:** Separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single `<script src="script.js" defer>` entry point; no inline styles.
- **Naming Convention:** BEM (`block__element--modifier`) for every custom class, used consistently — never mix conventions. The three spec-mandated classes (`.data-chart-flat`, `.status-indicator`, `.security-icon-simple`) are the only verbatim exceptions.
- **Copy:** Write real, polished English copy in a corporate-SaaS voice. Lorem ipsum is forbidden. Only genuinely unspecified link destinations may use `href="#"` with descriptive accessible labels.
- **JS Scope (script.js only):** Theme toggle + `localStorage` persistence + `prefers-color-scheme` fallback; mobile nav open/close; smooth scrolling (respect reduced motion); pricing billing toggle; FAQ accordion; email form validation with simulated submit (loading → success); IntersectionObserver reveal animations. No additional libraries or frameworks beyond Google Fonts/Icons and optional Tailwind.
- **Completeness:** Deliver the entire page — all sections, all component states, both themes — in one response on the first attempt.

## 5. LANDING PAGE SECTION-BY-SECTION SPECIFICATION

Page order: Sticky Header → Hero → Features → How It Works → Testimonials → Pricing → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer.

**5.1 Sticky Header**
Logo (Material Symbol `savings` or `account_balance` + wordmark), anchor nav (Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ), theme toggle (per 1.3), and a `.btn--primary` "Get Started" CTA. Mobile: hamburger button (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `menu`/`close` symbols) opening a flat slide-down panel; `Esc` closes; focus is managed.

**5.2 Hero**
Two-column flex layout (stacks below ~960px). Left: eyebrow badge (`.security-icon-simple` with `lock` + "Bank-Grade Security"), H1 (e.g., "Manage your money with total security"), supporting subheadline, CTA row (`.btn--primary` "Start Free Today" + `.btn--secondary` "See How It Works"), and a trust row of three `.security-icon-simple` items ("256-Bit Encryption" · "Read-Only Bank Sync" · "2FA Protection"). Right: a flat dashboard mockup `.card` containing a `.data-chart-flat` bar chart (7 bars, mixed green/red, labeled months and values), two `.status-indicator` chips (one positive, one negative), and a balance headline. Entrance uses fade/slide-up reveals; the mockup sways subtly on hover.

**5.3 Features (3 cards)**
Section header (eyebrow, H2, subcopy) followed by a 3-column grid (1 column on mobile). Card 1: **Bank-Grade Security** (`shield`) — 256-bit encryption, read-only bank connections, 2FA. Card 2: **Effortless Budgeting** (`account_balance_wallet`) — auto-categorized transactions, smart overspend alerts. Card 3: **Intuitive Insights** (`monitoring`) — flat charts and green/red status at a glance. Each card: icon tile, H3, copy, one `.status-indicator` or micro-detail; hover/focus states per 2.2.

**5.4 How It Works (3 steps)**
Three `.card` steps with large flat number badges (01/02/03) and Material Symbols (`account_balance` → `tune` → `trending_up`): "Connect your accounts securely" (read-only, encrypted sync) → "Set smart budgets" (automatic categorization) → "Track and grow" (real-time status indicators). Desktop: horizontal flex row joined by a flat CSS connector line/arrow; mobile: vertical stack with a left connector line.

**5.5 Testimonials**
Three `.card` quotes: a 5-star rating (repeated `star` symbols with `aria-label="Rated 5 out of 5"`), the quote, a flat avatar circle with the person's initials (flat palette fill with correctly paired text), name and role. Write realistic quotes about security, savings, and clarity. Optionally add a stat strip ("120,000+ users · $2.1B tracked · 4.9/5 rating") with count-up on reveal (reduced-motion safe).

**5.6 Pricing (3 tiers)**
Monthly/Yearly segmented toggle (`aria-pressed`, "Save 20%" on yearly) — prices update with `aria-live="polite"` and a fast transition. Tiers: **Starter** $0 (2 connected accounts, basic flat charts, monthly report); **Pro** — highlighted with a "Most Popular" badge (gold `--accent-gold` fill with `--text-primary` text) and emerald top border — $9/mo · $86/yr (unlimited accounts, budgets, goals, alerts, priority support); **Premium** $19/mo · $182/yr (investment tracking, family sharing, exports, advisor chat). Feature lists use `check_circle` icons; each card has a CTA (`.btn--primary` on Pro, `.btn--secondary` on others). The middle card is flat-elevated on desktop (2px border + `--shadow-md` + `translateY(-4px)`).

**5.7 FAQ**
Accessible accordion with 5–6 items (Is my bank data safe? · Do you sell my data? · Which banks are supported? · Is there a free plan? · Can I cancel anytime? · How does yearly billing work?). Question buttons carry `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; the `expand_more` chevron rotates 180°; panels animate height over 0.2s; fully keyboard operable; multiple panels may stay open; first item open by default.

**5.8 Final CTA**
Full-width flat panel: `--primary` deep blue background with `--text-on-primary` heading ("Your money, secured. Your future, organized.") and subcopy — dark background paired with light text in both themes (in dark mode, use `--bg-tertiary` with a `--primary-bright` border to preserve contrast). Centered email-capture `.input-group` (label, email input, `.btn--primary` "Create Free Account" with loading → success states, inline validation, `aria-live` status region) plus microcopy with a `lock` icon: "No credit card required · Cancel anytime".

**5.9 Footer with Secondary Links**
Top row: brand block (logo, one-line tagline, and an "All systems secure" `.status-indicator`) beside link columns — **Product** (Features, Pricing, Security), **Company** (About, Careers, Contact), **Resources** (Help Center, Blog, API), **Legal** (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy). If social/contact links are included, use available Material Symbols (e.g., `mail`, `rss_feed`, `chat`) with `aria-label`s — never inline SVG brand logos. Bottom bar: "© 2026 [Brand] — Built for secure money management."
